summary: ```# Quick Start Part 2: How to Make a Maid Outfit? (p03 Lantern Sleeves and Chest Pleats) ## Increasing the Volume of the Sound Next, let's learn how to increase the volume of the sound. ## Activating the Sleeves First, let's activate the two sleeves. We will create the effect of puffing. ### Creating an Opening Sleeve First, we are going to make an opening sleeve. This sleeve is a little bit narrower than the opening of the sleeve. This way, the length difference of the sleeve can form the effect of puffing and creasing. 1. In the 2D toolbar, use the rectangle tool to click and drag the mouse. 2. Draw a rectangle that is narrower than the opening of the sleeve. 3. Press the `N` key to switch to the line puffing tool. ### Fixing the Puffing Tool When using the line puffing tool, we will find that there is a break in the middle. Therefore, delete the break with the edit sheet tool. After that, the whole section can be puffed. ### Adjusting the Sleeve After that, we use the adjust sheet tool to select the middle sheet and press `Ctrl + D`. Place it under the other sleeve sheet. Then, right-click on the selected side and select "add to side." The side will automatically stick to the sleeve's side. However, when we open the simulation, we might find that the sleeve on one side is normal while the other side's may accidentally stick to the inside. In this case, we will choose to add to the side again to ensure correct identification. ### Sewing the Sides Once we have simulated and confirmed that the sides are correctly added, use the line puffing tool to sew the left and right sides together. When we pull it closer, we will see that there is a pointy corner on the side of the sleeve. ### Correcting the Sleeve Shape In fact, there is a straight corner on the side of the sleeve, which creates a pointy corner on the sleeve. The middle of the sleeve is divided again, resulting in a sharp corner, which we will fix later. ## Adjusting the Puffing Sleeve The curve of this puffing sleeve is not particularly obvious. If we want it to be more pronounced, we must adjust this version. 1. Select the side of the bottom plate. 2. Right-click and select "change length." 3. In the direction, select both to extend to both sides. I have changed the length to 300 mm here. By increasing the length of the bottom plate, we are effectively increasing the fabric, which results in more wrinkles. The angles on both sides become straight corners, creating a flat corner without sharp edges. ### Using the Extension Tool In addition to using "change length," we can also use the extension tool to spread the fabric. 1. Right-click and press the `Shift` key, then create a reference line at the end of the click. 2. After clicking the reference line, you can extend the plate to both sides. At this time, you will notice that although the extension plate has a fan-shaped area, the straight corners on both sides are still retained. By adding a fan-shaped area in the middle, the overall fabric increases, leading to more wrinkles. ## Making a Lantern Sleeve To create a lantern sleeve, we will use the change length or extension tool. This ensures that the lengths of the other lines remain the same and prevents unnecessary wrinkles. 1. Freeze the sleeve plate to prepare for the breast fold. ## Preparing the Chest Plate Next, since we have already made the sleeve plate, we will start to make the chest plate. If we need to adjust the chest plate, it may affect the sleeve plate due to its freezing. 1. Select the plates in the right-click menu. 2. Choose the anti-evolving plate and the seam line. The anti-evolving plate will maintain its current shape but will not participate in the simulation. Now, we can activate the plates on the chest. Once the simulation starts, the shoulder strap will not affect them. ## Adjusting the Elastic and Stitch Lines Let's review our previous work. Previously, we used elastic to fold the chest, but the sleeves usually have a line in the middle. 1. Now, select the lines at the neck. 2. Right-click and select the internal line. I set it to 10 mm here, then click OK. Next, we will cancel the ribbon on the stitch line in the Kollegen and the Too-Much-Forced-wasted arm, and apply the eligible ribbon on the newly manufactured magazine. ### Setting the Bow Return Ratio The ratio of bow return should be set to the default address number 80. When adjusting, if you double tap on one, the phalanx between the tra Lon link and this line is selected. ### Final Adjustments Let's do the same again. When theatorium is affected by the G-Kill casa, there will be some draw effect because we set the draw line to the internal line. If we reduce the particle diameter a little bit, for example, to 8, we will see that its wrinkle effect becomes more pronounced. There is a flexible ratio here. We can also reduce it from 80 to 70, similar to the 70 we set before. After all the adjustments, we can freeze these panels. Remember to use the freeze function frequently in the usual workflow. ```
